_comment: Listings verified as Toyota Genuine Parts. Only listings in `verified` are shown with the Toyota Genuine Part label. Add one only after confirming it against the Toyota part number on the supplier invoice or Toyota's parts catalog -- a supplier title saying 'Toyota Genuine' is not verification. Each entry: { "id": 1234, "partNumber": "35000-0K130", "verifiedBy": "name", "verifiedOn": "YYYY-MM-DD", "evidence": "invoice / catalog reference" }. Candidates awaiting review are listed in toyota-catalog.json under genuineCandidates.
